teaser.en: Digo farmers name at least eighteen kinds of mango, from *dodo* and *ngoe* to *shikio punda*, 'donkey's ear'.
teaser.sw: Wakulima Wadigo hutaja angalau aina kumi na nane za maembe, kuanzia *dodo* na *ngoe* hadi *shikio punda*, 'sikio la punda'.
teaser.dg: Akurima a Chidigo anataja aina za embe zisizophungukira kumi na nane, kula *dodo* na *ngoe* hadi *shikio punda*, 'sikiro ra punda'.

summary.en: *Mwembe* is the mango tree, a great evergreen that shades almost every homestead and market on the coast. Its fruit is eaten ripe or green, pickled and sold, and its trunk was once carved into dugout canoes.
summary.sw: *Mwembe* ni mti mkubwa wenye majani mwaka mzima unaotoa kivuli karibu kwa kila boma na soko pwani. Tunda lake huliwa likiwa limeiva au bichi, hutengenezwa achari na huuzwa, na shina lake zamani lilichongwa kuwa mitumbwi.
summary.dg: *Mwembe* ni muhi wa embe, muhi mkulu wenye makodza chila wakati unaopha pepho phephi kpwa chila mudzi na soko ra pwani. Matundage nkuriwa gachiivwa au gachiri ga chijani, nkuhendwa achari na kuguzwa, na kare kolore kala rinatsongbwa kuhenda mitumbwi.

about.en:
*Mwembe* is a big, long-lived evergreen tree with a dense, rounded crown. The leaves are long, narrow and leathery; new flushes come out a reddish-copper colour before turning dark green. Small cream flowers appear in branched sprays at the tips of the twigs.

The fruit hangs on long stalks and ripens from green to yellow, orange or red depending on the variety, around a large flat stone. Digo distinguishes many cultivars, among them *boribo*, *ngoe*, *dodo*, *batawi*, *chimaji*, *chisukari*, *epoli*, *zafarani*, *shikio punda* and *embe ra chidigo*.
about.sw:
*Mwembe* ni mti mkubwa unaoishi muda mrefu wenye majani mwaka mzima na taji nene la mviringo. Majani ni marefu, membamba na magumu kama ngozi; machipukizi mapya hutoka yakiwa na rangi ya shaba nyekundu kabla ya kugeuka kijani kibichi kilichokolea. Maua madogo ya rangi ya krimu hutokea kwa vishada vyenye matawi kwenye ncha za vitawi.

Tunda huning'inia kwenye vikonyo virefu na huiva kutoka kijani hadi manjano, machungwa au nyekundu kulingana na aina, likizunguka kokwa kubwa bapa. Kidigo kinatofautisha aina nyingi, miongoni mwake *boribo*, *ngoe*, *dodo*, *batawi*, *chimaji*, *chisukari*, *epoli*, *zafarani*, *shikio punda* na *embe ra chidigo*.
about.dg:
*Mwembe* ni muhi mkulu unaokala na moyo kpwa muda mrefu, wenye makodza chila wakati, na wenye chitswa chizito cha mviringo. Makodza ni marefu, membamba na mafu dza chingo; makodza maphya ganatuluka ga rangi ya kundu-shaba kabla ya kukala ga chijani chiru. Maruwa madide ga rangi ya maziya ganatuluka kpwa mabunda ganagoganyika kpwa ntsa za panda ndide.

Tunda rinabwadzika kpwa milita mire na rinaivwa kula chijani hadi rangi ya mandano, ya chungbwa au ya kundu, kulingana na aina, kuzunguluka koko kulu ra kubanika. Chidigo chinatafwautisha aina nyinji, kahi yao *boribo*, *ngoe*, *dodo*, *batawi*, *chimaji*, *chisukari*, *epoli*, *zafarani*, *shikio punda* na *embe ra chidigo*.

where.en: Large mango trees stand around nearly every homestead and market on the south coast, often as the main shade for meeting and selling. The fruiting season ends around July, and in the weeks before that the trees are heavy with fruit.
where.sw: Miembe mikubwa husimama karibu kila boma na soko katika pwani ya kusini, mara nyingi ikiwa ndio kivuli kikuu cha kukutania na kuuzia. Msimu wa matunda huisha karibu Julai, na katika wiki zinazotangulia miti hulemewa na matunda.
where.dg: Miembe mikulu inaima kanda-kanda ya phephi chila mudzi na soko kpwa pwani ya kusini, na kpwa kawaida ndiyo pepho kulu ya kuonana na kuguza. Msimu wa matunda unamala phephi Julai, na kpwa wiki za kabla ya hipho mihi inakala mizito kpwa matunda.

uses.en:
Mangoes are eaten ripe, or green with chilli and salt, and are made into pickles. Fruit is also sold, both locally and further afield.

The trunk has been carved into dugout canoes, and the tree also gives timber and firewood. Goats eat the leaves.
uses.sw:
Maembe huliwa yakiwa yameiva, au mabichi pamoja na pilipili na chumvi, na hutengenezwa achari. Matunda pia huuzwa, ndani ya eneo na hata mbali.

Shina limechongwa kuwa mitumbwi, na mti pia hutoa mbao na kuni. Mbuzi hula majani yake.
uses.dg:
Maembe nkuriwa gachiivwa, au ga chijani na pilipili na munyu, na nkuhendwa achari. Matunda piya nkuguzwa, hipha na kure.

Kolo rikatsongbwa kuhenda mitumbwi, na muhi piya unalavya mbao na kuni. Mbuzi nkurya makodza.

culture.en: Digo has a rich vocabulary for mangoes. A very ripe mango is *chinabo* or *chidobezo*, and the juice of a ripe mango is *ujinji*. The mango is so familiar that a forest tree, *Inhambanella henriquesii*, is called *mwembe tsaka*, 'forest mango'.
culture.sw: Kidigo kina msamiati mpana wa maembe. Embe lililoiva sana ni *chinabo* au *chidobezo*, na maji ya embe lililoiva ni *ujinji*. Embe linajulikana sana kiasi kwamba mti mmoja wa msituni, *Inhambanella henriquesii*, unaitwa *mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa msituni'.
culture.dg: Chidigo china maneno manji ga maembe. Embe ririroivwa sana ni *chinabo* au *chidobezo*, na madzi ga embe ririroivwa ni *ujinji*. Embe ni chitu cha kawaida sana hata muhi wa tsaka, *Inhambanella henriquesii*, unaihwa *mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa tsaka'.

names.en: The tree is *mwembe* (Pakia writes *muembe*) and the fruit *embe*. Swahili uses the same words. In English it is mango.
names.sw: Mti ni *mwembe* (Pakia anaandika *muembe*) na tunda ni *embe*. Kiswahili hutumia maneno hayohayo. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *mango*.
names.dg: Muhi ni *mwembe* (Pakia anaandika *muembe*) na tunda ni *embe*. Chiswahili chinahumira maneno higa higa. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *mango*.

reason.en: The forest tree named 'forest mango' after it
reason.sw: Mti wa msituni ulioitwa 'mwembe wa msituni' kwa kufuata jina lake
reason.dg: Muhi wa tsaka urioihwa 'mwembe wa tsaka' kula kpwa dzina ra mwembe

reason.en: A wild tree called the wild mango
reason.sw: Mti wa porini unaoitwa mwembe mwitu
reason.dg: Muhi wa weruni unaoihwa mwembe wa weruni

reason.sw: Pilipili, inayoliwa pamoja na embe bichi
reason.dg: Pilipili, inayoriwa na embe ra chijani

reason.en: Fellow homestead shade and fruit tree
reason.sw: Mti mwenzake wa kivuli na matunda wa bomani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa pepho na matunda wa midzi

definition.en: A very ripe mango that has turned reddish-orange.
definition.sw: Embe lililoiva sana na kugeuka rangi ya machungwa-nyekundu.
definition.dg: Embe ririroivwa sana na rikakala ra rangi ya kundu na chungbwa.
Embe ririroivwa sana na ra mtswano.

definition.en: The jelly-like juice of a very ripe mango.
definition.sw: Maji mazito kama jeli ya embe lililoiva sana.
definition.dg: Madzi ga yuya dza jeli ga embe ririroivwa sana.

definition.en: The mango stone (seed). Pakia gives this word only as a label on Fig. 3.6b, not in the text.
definition.sw: Kokwa ya embe (mbegu). Pakia anatoa neno hili tu kama kibandiko kwenye Mchoro 3.6b, si katika maandishi.
definition.dg: Koko ra embe (tembe). Pakia anapha neno hiri tu dza dzina kpwa Picha 3.6b, si kpwa maandiko.

definition.en: The cotyledons of the mango seed, which rise above the ground when it germinates.
definition.sw: Viini-jani vya mbegu ya embe, vinavyochomoza juu ya ardhi inapoota.
definition.dg: Makodza ga kpwanza ga tembe ya embe, ganagotuluka dzulu ya tsi ichimera.

meaning.en: Moon; Pakia suggests the shape is like a half moon.
meaning.sw: Mwezi; Pakia anapendekeza kwamba umbo lake ni kama nusu mwezi.
meaning.dg: Mwezi wa dzulu; Pakia anaona umboro ni dza nusu ya mwezi.
